El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Irrawaddy Delta: The Magical World of Mangroves
programme.desc: The Irrawaddy Delta in southern Myanmar is home to the most diverse mangrove forests in the world. The forests serve as natural protection against cyclones that regularly strike the region. The Irrawaddy's widely branching tributaries not only provide schools of fish and rich nutrients, but also function as the most important transport route for the people living in the delta. The greengrocer couple U Tin Hlaing and Daw Khin Lay supply the villages downstream with their fresh produce. But they do not go any further than the Meinmahla Kyun Wildlife Sanctuary. From that point on, the river becomes increasingly turbulent, too dangerous for their small, flat boat. The sanctuary is home to a variety of animal species including the rare Irrawaddy dolphins, saltwater crocodiles, birds of prey such as black kites and brahminy kites, migratory birds such as spoon-billed sandpipers, woodcocks, great cormorants and various anatids. Ranger Lha Soe Win and his colleagues regularly patrol the nature reserve to monitor the animal population and make sure the mangroves are no longer illegally logged for firewood. Since the 1970s, the mangrove population has declined by more than 60 percent, with dramatic consequences for the inhabitants of the delta. Cyclone Nargis, the most devastating cyclone to date, claimed the lives of around 130,000 Burmese in 2008. Together with scientists from the conservation charity Flora and Fauna International, the rangers are working on reforesting the mangroves to restore their function as a natural barrier in the future.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: Hardly any other area is as unspoiled as the Yukon Delta in western Alaska. This fascinating network of swamps and river arms looks like a landscape at the beginning of mankind. Only 25,000 people live in this barren region, which is almost as big as Greece. Most of these inhabitants are indigenous and belong to the ethnic group of the Yupik. They make their living on the steep banks of the Yukon River. And in their villages, built on piles to protect them against flooding, you can see the effects of climate changes on nature - and on the community life of the indigenous population. On the trail of the national fish of Alaska, the salmon, the film follows the Yukon River and follows moose hunters, migratory birds and scientists who do research in the delta.

programme.title: Nature's Survivors
programme.desc: Every year, the Earth is hit by cyclones, earthquakes, volcanoes and floods. These events make the headlines, with alarming human death toll numbers. But what about animals? This one-hour special explores how animals cope with natural disasters – before, during and after the events themselves. Animals have gone to great lengths to make the most out of some very perilous predicaments, and future climate change could force them to make even more changes in order to survive.

programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its extraordinary dimensions, as long as 10 meters, and shape in the form of silver ribbon, inspired the myth of the sea serpent. For the past two years, scientific buoys, immersed at a depth of two thousand meters in the Mediterranean off the French Riviera, have attracted countless species of pelagic fish, among them the Giant Oarfish also known as the "King of Herrings," drifting vertically, alone or by pairs. With the help of the world expert in Giant Oarfish and logistic collaboration of enthusiasts a scientific expedition reveals the biology of this enigmatic ambassador of the abyss.

programme.desc: Richard Kimble dates a waitress whose nephew's buddies plan to capture him with a mail-order rifle.

programme.desc: MacGyver is called in to test the unique security system of a top-secret research and development lab. The system, which is designed to entrap and exterminate intruders, malfunctions, trapping its creator, Jill Ludlum, and MacGyver inside.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.desc: Dr. Sloan tries to solve a friend's murder while Steve investigates the deceased's ex-wife and her identical twin sister.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: A visiting surgeon must deal with his alcoholism after a fellow doctor is murdered during one of his blackouts.

programme.desc: The Bradys comb the neighborhood in search of runaway dog Tiger.

programme.desc: Marcia becomes convinced she's ugly, ugly, ugly! after having to wear braces.

programme.desc: Mike and the kids run the house while Carol is out of town.

programme.desc: Edith is upset when she discovers Archie has forged her signature to get the bar. But Mike will influence Mrs. Bunker to change her mind.

programme.title: All in the Family
programme.desc: When Edith tells the story to the family in tears, Gloria and Mike believe she should report to the police. Gloria gets a call from the policemen asking her to identify the rapist. Edith is afraid, but Archie takes Edith to the police station.

programme.desc: Mama is surprised to learn she was entered in the Grandma USA contest by Bubba. She is reluctant to compete but changes her mind when she finds out the grand prize is a dream kitchen, complete with a self-cleaning oven.

programme.desc: Vint's former Army sergeant comes to town on a recruiting trip and he and Vint go out for a night of beers. Taking some advice from the Sargent he enlists in the military after being dumped by his girlfriend, to Mama's dismay.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: In this special 100th edition of Cold Case Files, we look at the biggest serial murder case in U.S. history; hunt for the Green River Killer. Dave Reichert, the detective who made finding the killer his obsession, walks us through the case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A bloody dagger and a phone tap help detectives solve a 20-year-old murder case. And DNA taken from an eyelash found on a dead prostitute's body brings a killer to justice.

programme.desc: The case of a gruesome stabbing death of a bullied teenager remains unsolved for 27 years.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: On a summer night in 1987, a 17-year-old girl to come home is found raped and strangled near the Hudson River. And In 1983, a young mother is raped and murdered at work. The crime remains unsolved for two decades.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Abstinence-pledged Darcy wakes up in a strange bed, screamingly hung-over. Panic-stricken, she tries to piece together the events of the night before. She knows – physically – she had sex, but everything else is a blank.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Paige is ecstatic to have landed herself a gig in the fashion world. If everything goes well, this could turn itself into a brand new career path.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After seeing Craig’s newly released album on the shelves at the record store, Ashley decides to pursue her own music – starting with a performance at the Lakehurst-Degrassi talent mixer.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Amidst the crowded classrooms and the battle for school territory, tensions between Lakehurst and Degrassi students continue to mount. But Spinner’s got his eye on enemy territory -- the adorably tough new Lakehurst girl, Jane.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Faced with his own aggression and looming mortality, Spinner attempts to prove his ‘masculinity’ by kicking an unnecessary amount of Lakehurst ass.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Manny’s moved back home but the honeymoon between she and her parents is just about over. And when her dad insists she have a traditional “Debut” – the lavish party many Filipino girls have for their 18th birthday – Manny takes a stand.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Ellie’s ex-mentor Caitlin Ryan arrives to do a guest lecture series in Jesse’s class and Ellie sees her opportunity to set herself apart from her peers. She throws herself into Caitlin’s class assignment and her hard work quickly pays off.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Emma decides she’ll do what it takes to get back on track, starting by rekindling her friendship with Manny, but when Manny wants to hit an audition to be a ‘Purple Dragon’ sports drink model, Emma finds herself quickly at odds with her best friend.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Spinner deals with chemo, timing how long he can go between barf-buckets, while his cheerleader Jane, tries to bring the party to him.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Marco and Ellie’s retail therapy goes awry when Marco finds his credit card maxed out. Ellie rescues him this time, but Marco realizes a new job is the real solution—and might even give him the opportunity to meet new people.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Roofie rape victim Darcy is barreling down a self-destructive path and only a handful of people know why.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Manny and Jay’s faux-mance is working perfectly. But when Jay gets too serious, Manny reminds him it's all fake.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After Manny discovers that her University demo reel is actually a sex tape that she and Jay made, her future hangs in the balance. By the time Jay catches up to her with the correct DVD, it's too late.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.sub-title: Got My Mind Set On You
programme.desc: When cute and funny Rachel joins Peter, Danny & Derek’s MI group for their “How-To” video project, confidence is high.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Mia’s finally been granted a spot on Spirit Squad, and she’s ecstatic. But trying to be a normal teenager is proving a difficult balancing act.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Paige is on her A game - she's excelling at work, Andrea's given her a raise, and she’s going to use the money to redesign her bedroom.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Since Snake’s suspension from teaching, Emma’s life has been turned upside-down. He’s really in a funk, and the dark cloud over his head has fouled the air at home, where Emma finds herself caught in the no-man’s-land between her parents.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Jimmy finally gets the news he’s been waiting for – he’s been accepted into NYU! But he’s got other things on his mind. He is slowly discovering that he has other options when it comes to his real dream – walking again.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: It’s Anya’s first year running the Free The Children Freedom Fast to promote education and health in Africa. She has a lot to coordinate - which would be hard enough without meddling Holly J, who’s determined to make Anya choose between her and Sav.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Mia’s renewed relationship with Lucas is making her feel like she’s on top of the world. With the extra free time afforded by his help, she's taking on all the high school things her parenting has kept her from enjoying.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.desc: Nanjing's Yunjin Brocade silk handicraft tradition dates back over 1,600 years, and is famous for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving, and vibrant, splendid patterns. programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Family Affair
programme.desc: Dog likes to say, "The apple doesn't fall far from the tree," and this is a hunt where that is true. So will Dog be able to use one family member's troubled ways to catch another one in trouble with the law?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Training Day
programme.desc: While the team tries to handle the bond that newcomer Alysin wrote incorrectly, sparks are flying between Beth and Duane Lee when he questions Beth's decision to go on the hunt without Dog leading the charge!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cutting the Apron Strings
programme.desc: Two different young men both have a bad habit of missing their court dates. Looking over their files Dog senses that they have another trait in common, both are a little too tied to their mothers.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Short Handed
programme.desc: Dog's target today has a history of violence, and apparently plans to re-locate without notifying the proper authorities. Unfortunately the team is missing a key player, Duane Lee is MIA today distracted by his new lady love.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Photo Op
programme.desc: Dog and Duane Lee can't agree about what role Duane Lee should have in the family business. But the family comes together as they set out to hunt a chronic violator with an open warrant and a wife who has an odd request for Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A House Divided
programme.desc: Dog has dropped Duane Lee from the team. When Leland confronts Dog and Beth about the decision tempers flare. But they have to come together to answer a cry for help from a mother who feels that the safest place for her daughter is jail.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All Grown Up
programme.desc: Cecily has graduated from High School and Dog believes the time is right to show her what the family business is all about. The rough and tumble world of bounty hunting is very different than the all girls private school she attended.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fight Like A Girl
programme.desc: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition, she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Higher Power
programme.desc: In an attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker. As Dog begins his hunt for a young man who has trouble showing up at court, Tim has his own mission - convince Duane Lee to meet with him.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Who's the Boss
programme.desc: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bus Stop Bruiser
programme.desc: When an alleged abuser goes on the lame, Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally, a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Behind the Hunt
programme.desc: The cameras are turned around, as we get a tour of life "behind the scenes" on Dog the Bounty Hunter. Using interviews with Dog and the posse, the TV crew, and never before seen footage, this is one of most revealing and heartfelt episodes of the series.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: God Looks on the Heart
programme.desc: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Brother
programme.desc: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in. Dog's plan is to convince family that everyone is best served if the fugitive mans up and takes care of business.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mid-Course Correction
programme.desc: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby's Back in Town
programme.desc: Dog tries to nab a fugitive, named Wayne, by calling and telling him that he's won a new vacuum cleaner and he should stick around to get it. Dog then sends his daughter, Lyssa, to "deliver" the vacuum cleaner and lure Wayne out of his house.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surprise! Surprise!
programme.desc: Dog and his team are out to revoke bail on Eugene, a chronic heroin addict. They find him in a squalid apartment with a huge stockpile of syringes, and they can see that his physical condition is deteriorating.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Ice in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog and his team fight the war on ice-crystal methamphetamine-on many fronts. They appear on a special anti-drug float in a parade. Then they go after bail-jumping Pana, a convicted drug dealer.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fathers in Law
programme.desc: Hunting down a fugitive known as "Bozo," Dog gets help from an unexpected source, Bozo's father-in-law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bosco the Clown
programme.desc: Dog and the team get a big surprise after they track down Bosco, a fugitive who they believe is addicted to methamphetamines. They discover he's off drugs, settling into a normal life with a new girlfriend, and is very friendly.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Leland has a full plate of fugitives in Kona, and the whole family heads to the Big Island to help.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mama's Boys
programme.desc: Dog visits his mother's grave for inspiration before heading out to find Frankie, a violent fugitive hiding in the jungle. The spirit of Ma Chapman seems to help when Dog finds an unusual ally; Frankie's mother.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Lost in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog lectures high school students about the dangers of drugs before going after Joseph, a dangerous fugitive who won't be easy to capture.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Coaching Day
programme.desc: Dog takes the day off to try his hand at coaching, and assigns Tim and Leland to track down a dangerous fugitive on their own. Can the boys prove they can handle it?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Women of Waikiki
programme.desc: The boys get distracted by the bikini-clad lovelies on Waikiki when they hunt for Lucy, a homeless, alcoholic fugitive. Beth is amused by the boys, but this is serious business: Tim will have to pay the bond if Lucy isn't caught.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When an alleged abuser goes on, the lame Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder, Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally, a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Baby Lyssa, who's just turned 18 and is studying to become a bondsman, gets to do some on-the-job training when she helps Dog hunt for Wayne, who's run out on a bond for second-degree assault.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold, it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Kimo does a vanishing act for his day in court, and now Dog and the posse have to find him. With precious few leads to follow, Dog turns to the fugitive's on again-off-again girlfriend, but she's initially reluctant to join the hunt.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting. When the fugitive's girlfriend offers to help Dog trap this dangerous felon, Dog knows that someone is being deceived, the only question is whom?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The team whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog kick-starts the search for Jackson, a 240lbs, six feet tall bad boy who has skipped out on a $10,000 bond. Jackson’s apparently at his father-in-law's house, but the father-in-law has info about Jackson that brings Dog to a unique hideout.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Baby Lyssa wakes up in a jail cell, but ignores the ensuing media frenzy in order to befriend a woman waging a personal battle against drug addiction.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and the boys are going after a fugitive with a $25,000 bond and a string of theft charges behind him. When the team hits his apartment, they find a boot print on the door, a souvenir of a police raid from only days earlier?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Back in Denver Dog discovers that recapturing the past can be more difficult then tracking down felons. On a day of more misses then hits in their fugitive hunting, Dog and Beth repeatedly collide with reminders of their early days.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem -- Duane Lee is sick.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog told him not to go, but Charles went anyway, skipping to Oregon against the terms of his bail. Now Dog has a tip that Charles plans to slip back into Honolulu. With $30,000 on the line Dog knows he can leave little to chance.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Today Dog and the family are back in Colorado and are about to make one of their most exciting captures ever. When the adrenaline-fueled arrest goes down, every family member will play a critical role.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is confronted with two alleged felons who are in crisis. Family and friends of these bondees are convinced that they are getting into further trouble while awaiting trial, so Dog and the posse have to bring these men back to jail.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When Beth returns to the compound on the Big Island, she finds a damaged SUV and two possible culprits--Dog or Justin. Pressed by Beth, Dog offers a third option. The perpetrators are Hawaii's mythical mischief makers--the Menehune!

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Chris Cope, a Florida transplant now living in LA. The city has been good to Chris in just 4 short years he's appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live, Tosh.O, Laughs on Fox. He's acted in feature films and also appeared on the hit ABC TV Show "Grey's Anatomy".

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

programme.title: Seth Knorr
programme.desc: Consistently skeptical, Seth Knorr graces the stage to wash away any preconceived notions regarding report cards, global warming, and family budgets.

programme.title: Myles Weber: Pug Life
programme.desc: Opening his set by describing himself as a series of white dudes, Myles Weber hones in on the humor of his life experiences in his special, joking about growing up in the hood, playing The Green Lantern in an amusement park, and his three-legged pug Taz.

programme.title: Alex Velluto

programme.title: Alex Velluto
programme.desc: Alex Velluto is a stand-up comedian and Diet Coke drinker from Salt Lake City, Utah. He has performed at comedy festivals all over the country including the Boston Comedy Festival, Big Sky Comedy Festival, and the Seattle International Comedy Competition. He was named “Best of Fest” at the Golden Spike Comedy Festival and is the winner of the Finger Lakes Comedy Festival in Ithaca, NY. In 2016, Alex was voted “Best Comedian” by City Weekly Magazine. His debut comedy special “Alex Velluto: Spurious” is currently streaming on Amazon.com.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Can't Hardly Weight
programme.desc: Gearing up for his high school reunion, Willie realizes that he could stand to lose a few pounds. Jase and Korie set out to help him drop some weight and the strenuous battle of man-versus-waistline begins.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Shot Thru The Heart
programme.desc: The guys learn from Willie that John Luke is going through his first break up. In order to make him feel better the men decide to take John Luke hunting for nutria, and impart their relationship wisdom.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Lizard, Lizard
programme.desc: When the warehouse guys new office pet (a lizard) escapes, they try all they can in order to catch the wily reptile. Proving impossible, the guys finally decide to bring in the big guns to help trap it--Mr. Phil Robertson.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hallu-Si-Nations
programme.desc: With Willie out-of-town, the guys decide to flake off work and leave to brush up the duck blinds on the Robertson land. While out, Si believes he spots what he thinks is the infamous 'Black Panther'.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Let's Go Hunting, Deer
programme.desc: Willie and Jase invite Korie and Missy along on a deer hunt because they believe their wives have become too "city." At Phil and Kay's, Miss Kay decides she wants to frame Phil's original blueprints from the first duck call he created.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Tickets To The Fun Show
programme.desc: During Duck Commander's "Casino Night" party, Si Robertson wins the grand prize of $2000 and decides to buy a massage chair for the duck call room. The massage chair becomes a detriment to the workflow, so Willie takes Si around for a replacement prize.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Be a Lady
programme.desc: Sadie, has a homecoming dance coming up, but Willie doesn't approve of her dress selection. Willie decides to take Sadie out to find her a new "appropriate" dress.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Ring Around the Redneck
programme.desc: Though Jase lost his wedding ring long ago, Missy decides it's time for Jase to replace it with a new one. When Jase is duck hunting, once again, he loses the ring.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bass Man Standing
programme.desc: The Duck Commander team is invited to unveil a wing of the local Bass Pro shop that will feature their products.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Battle of the Brothers
programme.desc: Willie's suspicious behavior from dyeing his beard to buying a new motorcycle, makes Jase come to the conclusion that Willie is having a mid-life crisis.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Aloha, Robertsons!
programme.desc: After all their hard work, Willie decides to take the entire Robertson clan on a family vacation to Hawaii. But Willie's daily itinerary for the trip gets constantly undermined by the family's desire to participate in their own island activities.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Till Duck Do Us Part
programme.desc: Everyone comes together to plan a surprise wedding for Phil and Kay, setting up a special ceremony on their land, which the whole family attends. Si distracts Phil and Kay by taking them on a "trip down memory lane".

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: So You Think You Can Date?
programme.sub-title: So You Think You Can Date?
programme.desc: After discovering that Martin has to miss a Friday night poker game for a date, the guys (as well as their wives) take turns figuring out the best way to coach him for romance. When babysitting for Jep and Jessica turns into a rocky road.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hot Tub Grime Machine
programme.desc: The guys realize that Godwin has never really asked them for a favor, even though they are all always helping each other out. Godwin asks them to help him get a hot tub, so they set out to help him pick one up.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A-Jase-ent Living
programme.desc: Due to construction at Jase and Missy's house, Willie and Korie invite Jase and the kids to live with them while Missy is out of town visiting friends. Then, what begins in the duck call room as a series of "Gentlemen's Bets".

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Termite Be a Problem
programme.desc: Because of a termite problem at Duck Commander, the guys are forced to find a different location to work from - Godwin's House. But while at Godwin's house, Godwin gets a taxidermied gift from a past relative.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: John Luke After Dentist
programme.desc: John Luke and Sadie are getting some dental work done, complete with sedation, and it's up to Willie and Korie to take care of them through the process - including getting them back home safely.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Scoot Along Si
programme.desc: Si shows up to work on a mobility scooter, claiming to have an invisible injury from a fender bender with Willie. After losing her beloved turtle "Mr. T", Ms. Kay enlists Phil on a mission to find a new pet turtle.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jerky Boys
programme.desc: A decision to try and make some duck jerky leads the boys to Godwin's garage and a minibike race. Phil and Kay have made Willie the executor of their will, and Phil wants to show Willie what he and his brothers will inherit when he and Kay pass away.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Going Si-ral
programme.desc: Si discovers Youtube, and, after watching a series of instructional videos, decides he can make something better. John Luke totals Willie's truck, and Willie realizes he may be raising the two worst drivers in all of Louisiana.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack-O-Lantern
programme.desc: The Robertsons host a Halloween event at Duck Commander, where they all come together to transform the warehouse into a "scarehouse." Everyone dresses up and Willie desperately tries to be the scariest, but none of the kids are afraid of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.sub-title: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.desc: The Robertsons perform a live nativity for their Church for Christmas, so the wives organize rehearsals to ensure that they pull off a great event. However, rehearsals get off to a bumpy start as the guys can't stop sharing their opinions.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Boomerang Becca
programme.desc: When Rebecca returns home from her internship in Los Angeles, the Robertson family plans a big surprise party to welcome her back. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si gets sick, he seeks the help of Ms. Kay to take care of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie's Number Two
programme.desc: When Willie is looking to hire a new assistant, Korie insists he interviews her cousin, JD. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si spends the day over at Phil and Kay's, Jep stops by with the kids to keep them away from Jessica, who has taken ill.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Life of Si
programme.desc: After seeing footage Jep shot using a GoPro, Si decides he wants to use the camera to record a day in his life. But when Si gets on the guys nerves while they're hunting, they kick him and his GoPros out of the blind.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: From Duck 'til Dawn
programme.desc: When the duck guys have to pull an all-nighter to finish some work, Willie decides he wants to join them. But when a dying smoke detector distracts them from their work, Jase and Willie head off to disarm it.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Burger Commander
programme.desc: After visiting a popular burger restaurant, Willie and Jase get into a debate over which of them cooks the best burger, prompting them to challenge one another to a cooking contest.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: G.I. Si
programme.desc: When Willie and Jase argue over an old G.I. Joe toy, it leads them into a debate over who would make a better soldier. To settle the score, Willie and Jase head out to the woods with their friends and children for a paintball match.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jase and the Argonauts
programme.desc: When Willie gets a soft serve machine for himself, he tells the guys they can't use it until they're done working. But when Jase thinks this is unfair, he takes matters into his own hands and finds a better object to use as motivation.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una limpieza de karma, una familia a la fuga
programme.desc: Enrique y Judith han tenido que recurrir a los tribunales para alcanzar el divorcio, ahora ambos luchan por la custodia de Dylan. Lola, por su parte, tampoco está pasando un buen momento. Secuestrada por las FARC en Colombia, espera resignada su rescate. Desde España Fermín, Javi y Estela hacen lo que pueden para reunir fondos. Además, Antonio Recio intenta ser un hombre bueno temeroso de su karma.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un masajista, un imán de chochetes y un príncipe
programme.desc: Incapaz de superar la infidelidad de su mujer y obsesionado con descubrir la identidad de su amante, Antonio Recio está convencido de que el responsable de su crisis matrimonial es el masajista de su esposa. Por otra parte, Fran, que se ha vuelto gótico, informa a su progenitor de su deseo de contraer matrimonio. Con el fin de acercarse a su hijo y comprender sus nuevas inquietudes, Enrique muestra interés en conocer a la novia del joven. Previamente al encuentro, el concejal de Juventud y Tiempo Libre del ayuntamiento redecora su apartamento y modifica su indumentaria siguiendo la estética gótica. Tras recibir una convocatoria para un castin de un anuncio de cereales, Estela acude al proceso de selección acompañada de Lola. La joven logra el puesto para protagonizar el comercial, pero provoca una guerra abierta entre madre e hija. Y es que Lola asegura haber descubierto su gran vocación: la interpretación.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Ante la falta de colaboración de Luisma (Paco León) en las tareas del hogar, Aída (Carmen Machi) decide echar a su hermano de casa. Con la calle como única opción de vivienda, Luisma acaba siendo arropado por un grupo de hippies al que acaba liderando. Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) y Jonathan (David Castillo) descubren un sobre lleno de dinero y no dudan en gastarlo en sus caprichos. Cuando se dan cuenta de que ese dinero es el que su madre iba a utilizar para arreglar la calefacción, se plantean dar la cara Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) ha sufrido un duro golpe: la redacción de Jonathan ha sido mejor valorada que la suya. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) anima a su hijo a vivir nuevas experiencias que le permitan escribir redacciones más divertidas, y Fidel se convierte en un bohemio.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Mauricio (Mariano Peña) ya puede ver crecer sus ingresos cuando se entera de que le ha tocado la Primitiva, pero todo se complica cuando le encarga a Luisma (Paco León) el sello del boleto... Chema (Pepe Viyuela)no está convencido de asistir a la reunión de antiguos compañeros de Universidad, además de no tener pareja, el tendero considera haber fracasado en su carrera. Sin embargo, Soraya (Miren Ibaguren) le acompañará y el ánimo de Chema dará un giro de 180 grados. Aidita (Sanseverina Lazar) tiene la divertida idea de esposar a su tío Jonathan (David Castillo) y a Fidel (Eduardo Casanova). Desesperados, los chicos intentarán liberarse pasando desapercibidos.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Sin intenciones más allá del mero recuerdo, Paz (Melanie Olivares) conserva los regalos de sus ex parejas, pero Luisma (Paco León) se molesta y aconsejado por Macu (Pepa Rus), decide obsequiar a su chica con una figura un tanto peculiar. Macu le pide a su amiga Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) que cuide de Luisito. Mientras hace de canguro, la García descubre que puede conseguir beneficio económico de las clientas de la peluquería donde trabaja si les hace creer que el pequeño es su hijo y lo tiene que mantener. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) y Chema (Pepe Viyuela) discuten por la propiedad de la tapa de un yogur premiada con un viaje. Mauricio compró el yogur en la tienda de Chema, pero fue el tendero quien se lo comió en el bar Reinols ¿Quién disfrutará del premio?

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Después de que la cocinera del bar Reinols haya decidió abandonar su puesto de trabajo por las pésimas condiciones laborales de Mauricio (Mariano Peña), el hostelero busca desesperadamente una persona que cubra el puesto. Ante la plaza vacante, es Junca (María La Vikinga) quien se ofrece para ser la nueva cocinera. Cuando lleva unos días trabajando, y haciendo las hamburguesas con carne de gato, Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) comienza a sospechar de la calidad del producto y decide investigarlo. Los resultados indican que la composición de la carne es mucho más alarmante de lo que parece Luisma (Paco León) y Barajas (Canco Rodríguez) buscan a el Pajuelas (Alejandro Tous), un íntimo amigo suyo de hace muchos años. Cuando por fin saben de él, descubren que su amigo es ahora el presidente de Aeronautic Space, una empresa aeronáutica de renombre. Emocionado con el reencuentro, el Pajuelas decide darles un puesto en la empresa con el fin único de ayudarles económicamente.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un suspenso, una psicosis y un romance...
programme.desc: Maxi convence a Enrique para montar un bar en la planta baja, en el lugar donde ahora se encuentra la peluquería de la exiliada Araceli. Cuando todos los vecinos se enteran de que van a realizar obras en el edificio saltan todas las alarmas e intentan hacer oposición para que la tasca no salga adelante.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un buzón de chivatos, un mayordomo en un Ferrari
programme.desc: Una inspectora de trabajo visita el complejo residencial de Mirador de Montepinar para investigar todas las irregularidades laborales de la urbanización después de recibir distintas denuncias de los vecinos. Estela y Fermín, por su parte, están decididos a hacerse ricos creando una clínica clandestina de cirugía estética.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un oso amoroso, unos mellizos postizos
programme.desc: La guardería de la esposa de Curro está muy cerca de la urbanización Mirador de Montepinar, así que decide visitarla buscando un piso de alquiler. Javi y Judith intentan matricular a su hijo en la guardería. Antonio Recio, por otra parte, empieza a tener miedo ante el inminente divorcio.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un chochete pasajero, una lesbiana con mochila y el padre Piruelas
programme.desc: Tras una década de enconadas luchas de poder por la presidencia, la apatía e indiferencia de la mayoría de propietarios harán acto de presencia en el complejo residencial, que vivirá grandes cambios: de conserje, cuando las largas vacaciones de Coque obligan a la junta directiva a buscarle sustituto; de convivencia, que llevarán a Antonio y a Coque a disfrutar sine die de la hospitalidad de Enrique y que animará a Fermín a instalarse en el ático de su amada Menchu; de estado civil, cuando diversas circunstancias ponen fin al noviazgo de Yolanda y Amador y al de Nines y Coque, convirtiéndoles en singles; y de alianzas, que propiciarán la floreciente amistad entre Fina y Amador y entre Yolanda y Lola. Además, la aparente estabilidad presidencial convivirá con nuevas hostilidades vecinales promovidas por Fina y las Morcillo que complicarán el delicado statu quo de Mirador de Montepinar. Tras descubrir que su mandato presidencial se ha prolongado más de lo debido, Vicente decide convocar elecciones contra la voluntad de Fermín, su amigo y asesor personal que se ha sentido realizado rigiendo el destino de Mirador de Montepinar en la sombra en el último año. Una junta de vecinos será el escenario de la elección del nuevo mandatario, que por sorteo recaerá en Bruno. Muy a su pesar, el consumado pianista se verá obligado a aceptar el cargo y abordar el 'caballo de batalla' que sus antecesores han venido eludiendo sistemáticamente: las vacaciones de Coque, al que tras diez años de duro trabajo le corresponden 104 días libres. Al frente de la comunidad, el concertista emprenderá la titánica misión de encontrar un conserje sustituto que no exija un salario elevado, empleo en el que probarán suerte variopintos candidatos.

programme.title: Monster Hunter
programme.desc: La oficial del ejército de Estados Unidos Natalie Artemis y su equipo buscan a un grupo de soldados misteriosamente desaparecidos en el desierto. Cuando encuentran sus últimas huellas, una tormenta repentina aparece en el horizonte.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una ruina política,una adúltera intermitente y la dura vida del cascacuores
programme.desc: Ilusiones amorosas y sonados fracasos sentimentales han sido una constante en las vidas de Raquel y Alba en los últimos años. Tras sentir la inexorable llamada de su reloj biológico, la hija de los Recio tratará de convencer a su amiga para que ambas se conviertan en madres al mismo tiempo. Sin embargo, el sueño de Alba peligra cuando una inquietante información de Berta le genera serias dudas sobre su posible maternidad. Conmocionados ante la posibilidad de perder sus viviendas, los habitantes de Mirador de Montepinar acuden a la plataforma de afectados por las expropiaciones en busca de ayuda. Entretanto, Enrique hace a Bruno una insólita propuesta: entrar en política como flamante fichaje de ACDC, el partido del que él forma parte. Asimismo, el floreciente negocio del Templo Kundalini de Maite se ve amenazado por las feministas, mientras la Cuqui pide a Amador que regrese 'reseteado' junto a ella, obligando a su exmarido a tener que elegir entre dos mujeres.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un kit de terrorista, una yoko ono y una visita
programme.desc: Al Mirador de Montepinar llega Gabi, un antiguo compañero de facultad de Javi que se ha convertido en un empresario emprendedor y multimillonario que le hará reflexionar sobre su vida. Además, Antonio pondrá la pescadería a nombre de Violeta, su hermana psicótica, para proteger su negocio durante el divorcio pero al final no es tan buena idea como parece.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un bohemio, unos labios carnosos y merengue...
programme.desc: Dos grandes estrellas del destape, Estela Reynolds y María José Cantudo, acuden a "Pelis de barrio", espacio conducido por José Manuel Parada, en el que la intérprete femenina de "Desembraga a fondo" intenta acaparar el protagonismo en un programa especial que recordará la exitosa carrera profesional de la actriz andaluza. Por otra parte, Enrique decide alquilar la vivienda del moroso a un matrimonio para sanear las maltrechas cuentas de la comunidad. Sin embargo, el carácter ruidoso y conflictivo de los nuevos inquilinos suscita las airadas quejas de los propietarios de "Mirador de Montepinar", por lo que Antonio decide poner en práctica un plan de urgencia que pretende poner fin a la convivencia de la pareja en el complejo residencial. Mientras tanto, Judith siente una gran atracción por el nuevo vecino, a quien intenta seducir ignorando que está casado.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Mauricio (Mariano Peña) decide poner un parquímetro en el barrio ganándose así el rechazo de los vecinos, que deciden hacerle pagar esta medida al guardia que vigila que se cumpla la misma. Después de ser víctimas de un atraco, Aída (Carmen Machi), Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa), Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso), y Paz (Melanie Olivares) se apuntan a clases de defensa personal, donde acabarán peleando entre ellas por la atención de Julián (Miguel Ángel Muñoz), el profesor. Mauricio obliga a su hermano Toni (Secun de la Rosa) a ganar su propio dinero, así que le contrata en el bar Reinols, en el que organiza una fiesta homosexual con la que Mauricio no acaba desencantado. El acuerdo entre Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) y Jonathan (David Castillo) con respecto al destino del viaje de fin de curso parece imposible. Mientras que Fidel insiste en visitar los museos de Grecia, Jonathan avoga por disfrutar de las vistas femeninas en Canarias. Ambos llegan a la conclusión de que decidirá el que más dinero recaude

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Jorge Sanz (Jorge Sanz) llega al barrio para buscar inspiración en el papel de su próxima película. El actor tendrá que interpretar a un ex drogadicto, y se pega a Luisma para empaparse de su forma de ser. Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) decide animar a Soraya (Miren Ibaguren) a que salga con ella y sus amigos. Para sorpresa de Lorena, su hermana mayor resulta ser muy divertida y acaba siendo popular en la pandilla. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) busca pareja para derrotar a un rival en los dardos. Chema (Pepe Viyuela), el elegido sorprende a todos

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Después de todo lo vivido en 7 vidas, sitcom de la que nace esta serie, Sole (Amparo Baró) llega a Esperanza Sur para visitar a su amiga Aída (Carmen Machi). Sole se encuentra en el bar Reinols cuando Mauricio (Mariano Peña) le echa una gran reprimenda a uno de sus camareros. Debido a una mala interpretación, Sole cree que el hostelero ha matado a su empleado y decide avisar a la policía Por su parte, Luisma (Paco León) recibe inesperadamente una gran cantidad de dinero que decide derrochar con su madre, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso). Cuando el banco comunica el error, Luisma tiene que devolver el dinero. Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) quiere que Paz (Melanie Olivares) pose desnuda. Cuando Jonathan (David Castillo) se entera, no dudará en aprovechar la situación y sacarle partido económico con sus amigos.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Chema tiene una contractura y acude a aplicarse un masaje chino que, inesperadamente y sin que pueda hacer nada por evitarlo, termina con un "final feliz".

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un pique, un show y un cuenco tibetano
programme.desc: Los vecinos de la comunidad descubrirán que el negocio que Enrique proyecta es un bar. Cuando éste les invite a la inauguración del local, la reacción de los vecinos será sumamente positiva, salvo la de los Recio, que decidirán introducir droga en la fiesta de apertura del establecimiento con el fin de que Enrique sea detenido y el local, clausurado. Sergio cumplirá un sueño que tiene desde niño: la posesión de un inmenso Scalextric. Sin embargo, la consecución de este anhelo entrañará cuantiosos problemas, ya que Joaquín acusará a su hermano de inmaduro. Además, el joven no encontrará el espacio necesario para instalarlo, por lo que pedirá permiso a Javi y Lola, sus vecinos de enfrente, para instalarlo en el rellano. La cena de parejas entre Amador y Maite y Javi y Lola en el ático B finalizará con el misterioso robo de un cuenco tibetano.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una limpieza de karma, una familia a la fuga
programme.desc: Enrique y Judith han tenido que recurrir a los tribunales para alcanzar el divorcio, ahora ambos luchan por la custodia de Dylan. Lola, por su parte, tampoco está pasando un buen momento. Secuestrada por las FARC en Colombia, espera resignada su rescate. Desde España Fermín, Javi y Estela hacen lo que pueden para reunir fondos. Además, Antonio Recio intenta ser un hombre bueno temeroso de su karma.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un hombre salvaje, una vieja maldita y un fantasma
programme.desc: Tras la llegada al 2ºC de Doña Fina, una anciana solitaria, desconfiada y problemática, la convivencia en el inmueble se verá amenazada. Por otro lado, Maite cumple el tercer grado penitenciario en el 1ªA con una pulsera telemática y Amador decide abandonar su vida de "bosquehumano" en el monte y regresar a la civilización.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un vacío de poder, una inutilidad manifiesta y un ser maligno y cansino
programme.desc: Bruno está deprimido y no se ve incapaz de proseguir con las obligaciones de su mandato, así que se convoca una junta extraordinaria en la que se Menchu es proclamada presidenta sustituta. Coque, sobrecargado de trabajo y aconsejado por Chusa, hace dejación de sus funciones para forzar un despido con indemnización. Mientras tanto, Berta decide separarse 'espiritualmente' de Antonio, que ahora tendrá que ocuparse de la casa. Por otra parte, la vida familiar de los Cuquis se ve amenazada cuando una jueza otorga la custodia de sus hijos a Teodoro, obligando a Maite a abandonar su vivienda. Las presiones de su editor sobre el plazo de entrega de su próxima novela erótica llevan a la escritora a tomar medidas desesperadas. Tras contraer matrimonio, Vicente insta a Fermín a buscar trabajo. En su nueva faceta como médium, el padre de Lola atenderá a sus clientes en casa, donde tratará de ponerles en contacto con sus familiares difuntos.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un sabotaje, una mami coleguiti y un trastrás por detrás
programme.desc: Durante su estancia en la clínica de salud mental, Bruno conoce a Agustín Gordillo, un peculiar paciente que se hará pasar por su psiquiatra. Antonio Recio, resentido con Menchu que lo ha sustituido, quiere provocar una derrama para desacreditar la labor de la reciente presidenta, que pide ayuda a Enrique. Berta se ve obligada a hacerse cargo de la joyería familiar tras el accidente de su madre. A Lola se le ocurre un juego erótico para combatir la rutina sexual de su matrimonio con Javi. Amador se plantea utilizar 'Charlacar', una popular aplicación para compartir coche para acudir a una entrevista de trabajo en Barcelona.

programme.title: Predator: La presa
programme.desc: Naru es una joven guerrera, feroz y altamente hábil, que se crió a la sombra de algunos de los cazadores más legendarios que deambulan por las Grandes Llanuras. Cuando el peligro amenaza su campamento, se dispone a proteger a su gente. La presa a la que acecha y, en última instancia, se enfrenta, resulta ser un depredador alienígena evolucionado con un arsenal técnicamente avanzado, lo que deriva en un enfrentamiento cruel y aterrador entre los dos adversarios.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una envidia fálica, una ferretería satánica y una conexión próstata-cerebro?
programme.desc: Tras hacer realidad su anhelado sueño de ostentar la presidencia de Mirador de Montepinar en un segundo mandato, a Antonio Recio se le acumulan los problemas en distintos frentes: su matrimonio con Berta sufre evidentes muestras de desgaste, su relación paternofilial con Alba atraviesa un difícil momento y el proceso de expropiación del edificio avanza rápida e inexorablemente. Ante este sinfín de calamidades, Antonio decide abandonar sus ideales y vender su alma al demonio. Mientras, a través de una app para encontrar pareja, Yoli y Lola acaban conociendo a un hombre por el que ambas se sienten atraídas y que oculta un oscuro secreto. Además, Amador, inmerso en un mar de dudas, afronta un complejo dilema: seguir el dictado de su corazón y apostar por Irene, la atractiva veterinaria por la que se siente irremediablemente atraído, o decantarse por el 'reseteo' que le ha ofrecido Maite. Raquel, por su parte, recibe exultante la transferencia del embrión, cuando un hombre ideal se cruza repentinamente en su vida.

programme.sub-title: Dos juicios, un reality-show y una masajista...
programme.desc: Recio ha localizado a Santiago, el exmarido de Rebeca, que llega a Mirador de Montepinar dispuesto a reconciliarse con su exmujer. Quiere que le perdone por haberle sido infiel. Judith regresa a la urbanización y trata de llevarse bien con Enrique para que no le ponga trabas con la custodia de su hijo y poder así recuperar su apacible vida en Chicago. Araceli, por su parte, termina el romance con Berta a través de una nota. El disgusto de Berta es tal que se le desprende la retina. Recio no pierde ocasión de aprovechar eso en el divorcio. Mientras tanto, Lola le deja claro a Estela que no piensa pagarle la boda con Fermín, así que la diva intentará vender la exclusiva del enlace a una revista del corazón para financiar el evento. Maite consigue trabajo por fin: en un centro de masajes relajantes.

programme.title: Rubí

programme.title: Infinito amor

programme.title: La rosa de Guadalupe

programme.title: Sabor a ti, entre historias y secretos

programme.title: Tierra de amor y coraje

programme.title: Stormborn
programme.desc: The animals of the north face worsening weather in autumn and the first stirrings of winter. Grey seals and reindeer turn their attention to mating, hormones run wild as males compete, and young animals venture away from their parents for the first time. In Iceland, the cliff Arctic fox family is thriving, but it’s a different story for the foxes denning at the shoreline. Only one of the cubs has survived. Now, abandoned by her parents, she must fend for herself.On the Monach Isles, 35,000 grey seals arrive for the annual breeding season. A pup faces danger on the beach, getting lost and swept up into a fight between two raging bulls. As winter arrives, the reindeer herd in Norway must migrate to their grazing grounds in the mountains, but this involves a perilous two-mile swim across open water.

programme.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Wild Sky
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africa’s wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

programme.title: The misfit comes of age
programme.desc: The Mwamba lion pride are the largest in Zambia's Luangwa Valley - three dominant males, several experienced lionesses, plus their yearlings--adolescents on the cusp of adulthood. The future of the pride depends on these yearlings learning to hunt quickly, but an ambush by a local hyena clan has set them back. To survive, they will have to hone their skills and start contributing to the hunt.

programme.title: The misfit comes of age
programme.desc: For lion cub Milo, being born into a strong clan in the Luangwa Valley should be enough to secure his future. But a devastating loss triggers a chain of events that sees him rejected by his parents. As the sole surviving cub, he has become a burden for the pride. If Milo is to win his way back into favor, he will need to fend for himself and prove he can keep up--but does he have what it takes?

programme.title: Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China’s land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.title: Arabian Seas
programme.desc: A seahorse blends perfectly into its coral surroundings, while a male day octopus hides to avoid the female's cannibalistic impulses. programme.title: Arabian Seas
programme.desc: Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just can’t resist.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: America's Alien Wars
programme.desc: Has our government been at war with alien aggressors for the past half century? Startling evidence indicates that the US military has been under attack and has kept it from the public.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Zombies
programme.desc: This episode explores what would happen if a zombie outbreak ever became a reality.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Haarp
programme.desc: Governments around the world may be using weather control to incite the next World War and possibly destroy the planet.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Cloning
programme.desc: Disturbing experiments in animal cloning go on behind closed doors and human cloning may soon be a reality.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: America's Flying Saucer
programme.desc: Discover America's new killer aircraft and the out-of-this-world technology the US military uses to conquer the globe.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Secret Government Warehouses
programme.desc: From Fort Knox to Hangar 18 and Camp Hero, discover a series of top-secret and high-security national database centres.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Mind Control
programme.desc: There are those who wish to control what others think, how they act and what they believe. Discover the new practices in mind-control.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Top Ten Secret Societies
programme.desc: An elite group of power players may be plotting the fate of the planet. Discover the secrets behind ten powerful hidden organisations around the world.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Global Depopulation
programme.desc: Disasters, famine and pandemics threaten civilisation on a global scale. A cataclysmic event may spell the end of civilisation and the human race could face extinction.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Nazis Today
programme.desc: For decades, there have been rumours key members of Hitler’s inner circle escaped the fall of Berlin - maybe even the Führer himself. But where did they go and what is their plan?

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Stargate Portals
programme.desc: Discover doorways to wormholes in time, their secret locations around the world, as well as who is trying to open them and why.

programme.title: Alien Files Unsealed
programme.desc: Alien Bodies: Uncover the shocking truth about alien remains as experts investigate unsettling reports of extraterrestrial bodies recovered from crashed UFOs.

programme.desc: Do males prefer women with blonde hair? Do pheromone sprays work? Are women attracted to wealthy men? Do men give larger tips to women with larger breasts?

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 174

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 178

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 5

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 147

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 61

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 63

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 23

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 180

programme.title: MythBusters: Episode 118

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri siguen besándose. Cada uno de ellos pensando en lo feliz que se sienten. El se despide de ella y quedan en no hablarse más. Carolina le forma un escándalo a Segundo por besarla pero piensa que le gusta más que los besos de Juan Diego. Se van del local. Atanasio sigue aconsejando a Juan Diego en lo que se refiere a las mujeres. Wilker anima a su mamá a que se consiga un novio para que la acompañe. Ella le dice que no | que lo que quieres es que se case y tenga bastantes nietos.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel León es un famoso presentador televisivo famoso por su vitalidad y buena presencia pero en uno de sus programas sufre un desmayo y entonces va al médico y este le dice que deberá hacer un tratamiento de diálisis o hacerse un trasplante. Gabriel le confiesa esta verdad a su manager y amigo Epicúreo y también le dice que el donante será uno de sus hijos que no conoce pero que sabe que existen porque cuando tenía 18 años fue donante de esperma y le encarga a Epicúreo que se ocupe de encontrar a esos hijos. Epicúreo se hace pasar por diferentes roles y consigue la información que Gabriel estaba buscando o al menos algo de ella.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Amparo revela a Moisés que su padre está vivo, desatando tensiones familiares mientras Elizabeth exige la verdad. Benjamín anuncia su boda con Hortensia, provocando el rechazo de Ricardo, quien exige separación de bienes. Alejandro intenta disuadir a su padre de una venganza sangrienta tras salir de prisión. Mientras tanto, Gustavo busca a María del Pilar pese a que ella ya está con Marcelo, y Manuela rechaza la propuesta de Misael en medio de conflictos familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo reclama a Isaías por el dinero perdido y lo acusa de vivir con Rosa; Isaías defiende a Rosa diciendo que podría ser su hija. Salvador rompe con Vilma quien jura venganza. Erasto descubre que el dinero desapareció y culpa a Eustoquio. Junior se enfrenta a Rosa por Isaías y cae desmayado; ella lo lleva a la clínica gritando auxilio. Alejandro enfrenta a Erasto y lo amenaza con la Fiscalía. Erasto coloca camisa de fuerza a Natalia y la golpea. Carmen Rosa explica a Chencha por qué calla la verdad sobre Consuelo, jurándole no revelar nunca el secreto.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene y Leonardo vuelven del viaje y Felipe los espera ansioso. Alejandra se entera de que se filtró un correo donde piden a alguien para su puesto y confronta a Leonardo, quien la saca violentamente de su oficina. Rodrigo amenaza a Rebeca con revelar todo el plan si Adolfo y ella deciden traicionarlos. Además, le pregunta qué pasaría si se supiera que ella es la asesina de Miguel Ferrándiz. Anzola le declara su amor a Trinidad y esta lo rechaza. Jimena tiene una dura conversación con Carlos Ernesto en la cual él le pide que lo deje amar a Virginia. Luego, Jimena se enfrenta a Virginia y le confiesa que tiene dudas sobre la autoría del crimen. Virginia le dice que ama a Carlos Ernesto y que luchará con todo para limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El socio de Heriberto lo visita en la cárcel para confesarle que ahora se alió con Reina para secuestrar a Alejandro, ya que ella le pagará más.Reina lleva sedado a Alejandro a un hotel y lo hace pasar por parapléjico, pero cuando sale olvida su teléfono, y Alejandro aprovecha para llamar a Sol y contarle que lo tienen ahí, y también pedirle que llame a la policía. Luego Reina regresa antes que Alejandro escape, y se lo lleva junto a su nuevo socio en una camioneta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia siguen con la repartición de regalos. Olegario y Junior están acompañando a Fabián que está sumamente triste por no estar pasándola con su Finita e hijas. En la agencia siguen con los regalos. Ana ya le regaló a Pastor y Pastor a Mauricio. Lolita y Dionisia quieren atender a ROKUro como un rey. El tiene pena. Carolina sigue pensando en el beso de Segundo y viendo la hora que es y Juan Diego no la llama. Juan Diego le regala a Yubiri y se abrazan.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel conoce a Magdalena. Ella es la encargada de sacarle las fotos para la campaña publicitaria. Es muy dulce y queda enganchado con ella. Epicúreo va a entrevistar a Valentina Pacheco, pero con una información errónea. Y ella empieza a pensar en la hija que tuvo y dio, mediante fecundación in Vitro. Julieta siente que está defraudando a sus padres, por trabajar en un periódico de chimentos. Angie (esposa de Gabriel) está muy enojada porque él apaga su teléfono y no consigue localizarlo. Magdalena invita a Sofía (su ginecóloga) a cenar a su casa para ver si existe la posibilidad de tener otro hijo. Agustín se enoja con Sofía (que es su amante). Ya que le había pedido que dijera que eso era imposible, sin embargo Sofía afirma lo contrario.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Moisés descubre la verdad sobre su padre biológico y confronta a Benjamín. Alejandro confiesa que no es cura. La muerte de la Nona en Italia sacude a todos, mientras Katiuska y Hortensia conspiran con Benjamín para robar el testamento y asegurar la herencia. Manuela enfrenta insultos de su familia tras dar la noticia de la muerte. Entre tensiones familiares y revelaciones de secretos del pasado, los personajes lidian con el caos, el alcoholismo y la ambición por la fortuna.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Isaías culpa a Eustoquio de su pasada estancia en cárcel por los dólares falsos. Alejandro engaña a Arminda haciéndola creer en una cita; Consuelo se prepara. Eustoquio manipula a Isaías ofreciéndole dinero para pagarle a Adolfo. José Luis prepara una operación comando con sus amigos para rescatar a Natalia. El médico informa a Adolfo y Marisela que a Junior le queda poco tiempo de vida. Consuelo amenaza con matar a Arminda; ella revela que la hija está viva. Carmen Rosa se ahoga en sus recuerdos del pasado. Leticia descubre que su carro no tiene frenos y entra en pánico.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia siguen con la repartición de regalos. Olegario y Junior están acompañando a Fabián que está sumamente triste por no estar pasándola con su Finita e hijas. En la agencia siguen con los regalos. Ana ya le regaló a Pastor y Pastor a Mauricio. Lolita y Dionisia quieren atender a ROKUro como un rey. El tiene pena. Carolina sigue pensando en el beso de Segundo y viendo la hora que es y Juan Diego no la llama. Juan Diego le regala a Yubiri y se abrazan.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe duda del amor genuino de Irene y le pide que se casen. Irene le plantea varias preguntas cuyas respuestas decidirán si se casa con él o no. Pero luego Felipe recibe la inesperada visita de Leonardo, quien le reclama acerca de la verdadera paternidad de Mateo. Tras una acalorada discusión, Leonardo se retira. Virginia le cuenta a Irene acerca de la propuesta matrimonial de Anzola, cuando alguien toca el timbre. Es Rodrigo que viene por María Lucía, pretende invitarla a Europa y darle una vida de lujos. Rebeca cambia la medicación de Agustina y esta última sufre un colapso nervioso del que son testigos Coromoto, Jimena y Adolfo. Adolfo amenaza nuevamente a Rodrigo y lo insta a que frene la reapertura del caso de Miguel Ferrándiz.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina es apresada y luego la atropella un automóvil. Heriberto le escribe una carta a Sol y le hace creer que hicieron el amor. Víctor Hugo es apresado por Maricielo. Tras su arresto, Carlos le reprocha a Alicia el haber sido la responsable de la muerte de Ramón. José Domingo se entera de que puede ser el padre de Alicia y Alejandro. Eloy y Columba se reconcilian. Cristo José le dice a Bárbara que se va a divorciar pero también le comenta a Giselle que tampoco quiere estar con ella.
